verdicts.reason: A has a clean stacked order (headline, body, CTA, legal), but the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has dropped below the headline at an unreadable micro size, the logo is tiny, and the orange divider rule is stranded under the legal text. B is worse: the header bar is cropped so the sun logo is cut at its edge and the SOLSTICE wordmark spills faint onto the cream background, the eyebrow floats alone in a large dead gap mid-canvas, and the CTA is pushed far from its copy.
